title: The build catalog gets lighter
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: Tank Arena's build catalog is now a committed file that a test keeps in step with the rules, and build checks use a fixed table and a small hand-written writer. The browser engine is also compiled as one unit.

The browser build shrinks from 338 KB to 300 KB (about 11% smaller). The catalog code itself still costs about 24 KB, and the single compile unit wins back about 17 KB from existing code. The JavaScript functions, every pinned hash, replay and parity fixture are unchanged, and matches run at the same speed or slightly faster.
next: Blitzwing's racing catalog, in the same shape.
